scope: Source-only arrivals preparation and recoverable raw-source archival. No new arrival geometry, real fixture relocation or lighting bake has been promoted. No fresh browser/FPS/mobile acceptance claimed.

checks: Four exact archived checkpoint records validate retained HDR hashes, 0.18 controls and bake coverage against regenerated lossless full/fallback derivatives; no current runtime dependency
Schema2 resolves exactly the two local atlas children; missing/duplicate/wrong-zone/traversal references and ambiguous source directories are rejected
Schema3 requires the dedicated local order atlas, rejecting missing-order and traversal substitutions
Only the exact Phase5 vault source directory is accepted, with linear transfer and an 8K full atlas; other zones, traversal/alias paths and a 6K derivative are rejected
Optional referenced access atlas validates exact Phase6 raw/denoised directories, linear input,2048/512 lossless pixels, raw+retained decoded HDR hashes and byte-identical raw/runtime bake reports
Unreferenced access records do not change legacy validation; a half-referenced atlas or missing matching access report is rejected
Access traversal/alias paths,wrong zones or transfer,missing archive fields,corrupted raw/retained HDR hashes and unequal bake-report bytes are rejected
Access source resolution cannot exceed2048; undersized full/low derivatives and changed same-size source pixels are rejected

Separate Phase7 circulation2048/512 source/derivatives pass alongside unchanged Phase6 access provenance; reject path aliases, wrong family/source transfer, raw/archive/report corruption, half references and mismatched records

Separate Phase8 arrivals4096/512 provenance coexists with Phase6 access and Phase7 circulation; rejects path/family/transfer substitutions, raw/report corruption, undersized sources/derivatives and half references
Failed0.18 controls,incorrect source transfer,empty radiance/AO and the observed collapsed UV-atlas failure are rejected
Explicit and implicit .hdr.gz archival preserves original HDR bytes; a wrong decoded SHA is rejected
Same-size changed PNG pixels and unsupported derivative dimensions are rejected
